system.flavor: 40mm gel bean bag: 2D6 bruising, a Stun/Shock Save at -5. Range 50 m.
system.notes:
THE BOOK: Home of the Brave p.86, "Bean Bag: This round is a 'bean bag' of gel. It has an effective range of 50 meters, and does 2D6 damage to the target (this is actual bruising tissue damage). Armor stops this damage as normal." The target also makes a Stun/Shock Save at -5, +1 per full 15 SP of armor.

MODEL: the +1 per 15 SP on the save is by hand.

MODEL: the round has no blast radius of its own, so blastRadius is 0.5 m - the module's area flow then reaches the target's own square and nothing beyond it (a 0 would fall back to the 5 m grenade row of CP2020 p.99).
